title: Shared users
desc: Users shared by WebDAV, FTP and SMB; changes on any service page apply to all of them
help: Shared users have a password and directories just like local users and are kept in one place. With the switch on they can sign in to this service; when a local user has the same name, only the local user is checked.
helpSmb: Shared users have a password and directories just like local users and are kept in one place. With the switch on they can sign in to this service; when a local user has the same name (case-insensitive), only the local user is checked. SMB needs plain passwords, and user and share names cannot contain characters such as " / \ [ ] : ; {'|'} = , + * ? < >.
off: Shared users are off for this service, the users below cannot sign in to it
loadError: The shared user configuration is invalid and shared users cannot sign in; fix it and save to restore them: {error}
shadowed: Same name as a local user, the local user is checked: {names}

issue.name: {name}: the user name cannot be used for SMB
issue.bcrypt: {name}: the password is a bcrypt hash; SMB needs the plain password, please set it again
issue.share: {name}: a directory name cannot be used as an SMB share name or is duplicated
